data.description: Bitter and blasphemous, redcaps cannot stand the symbols of good-aligned religions.  If a foe spends a standard action presenting such a holy symbol, any redcap that can see the creature must make a DC 15 Will save or become frightened for 1 minute and attempt to flee.  A redcap who successfully saves is shaken for 1 minute.
data.name: Irreligious
